title: ATLAS
music_tags: epic battle orchestra, taiko drums, war choir, heavy low brass, string ostinato,
script: This pack is nine years old.
The stitching is doubled where every other pack tears first.
It is heavier than the light ones. That is the trade, and we are not going to pretend otherwise.
ATLAS. Buy it once.

title: LUMEN
hook: LUMEN / light that knows the hour
music_tags: hopeful rising strings, arpeggiated piano, soft swelling brass, gentle percussio
script: Most desk lamps have one setting: on.
LUMEN moves with the day. Cool and bright when you need to think.
Warm and low when you need to stop.
LUMEN. Light that knows what time it is.
captions: LUMEN - light that knows the hour

title: NORTHWIND TEA
music_tags: warm nostalgic strings, soft piano, gentle, hazy, wistful, instrumental
script: Some mornings you need the day to start slowly.
Northwind is a plain black tea. No claims, no ceremony.
Grown on a hillside, dried slowly, packed the same week.
Northwind. Take the long way through the morning.
captions: Dried slowly. Packed the same week.

title: PACE
hook: PACE / built for the fifth mile
music_tags: driving percussion, ostinato strings, insistent low brass, forward motion, instr
script: The first mile is easy. Anyone can sell you the first mile.
PACE is built for the fifth. Where the cushioning usually gives up.
A denser midsole that holds its shape when you are tired and sloppy.
PACE. The mile that counts is the one after you wanted to stop.
captions: Anyone can sell you mile one
Holds its shape when you are tired
PACE - the mile after you wanted to stop

title: SLOW SUNDAY
music_tags: warm nostalgic strings, soft piano, gentle, hazy, wistful, instrumental
script: Sunday used to be a whole day.
Slow Sunday is a coarse ground for a slow brew. It takes eight minutes.
That is the point. You cannot rush it, so you do not.
Slow Sunday. Nowhere to be.
captions: Sunday used to be a whole day
You cannot rush it, so you do not

title: TIDEWATER
hook: TIDEWATER / three things, that is all
music_tags: gentle sunrise ambient, soft solo piano, warm string pad, distant solo clarinet,
script: The shelf is full of bottles with twenty ingredients.
Tidewater has three. Water, glycerin, and an oil pressed from seed.
Nothing that needs explaining. Nothing that needs a chart.
Tidewater. Three things, and none of them is a promise.

title: THE DOOR
hook: do not open it / until you know
music_tags: low drone, dissonant sustained strings, sparse metallic hits, unsettling, instru
script: Every building has one door nobody opens.
In this one, the room on the other side is bigger than the building.
Which is a problem, because somebody is already inside.
captions: The room is bigger than the building

title: THE GARDEN
hook: it grew overnight / all of it
music_tags: low drone, dissonant sustained strings, sparse metallic hits, unsettling, instru
script: On Monday there was nothing here but frost and dark soil.
By Tuesday there were shoots. By Wednesday they were at the fence.
It is Friday. The shed is gone.

title: THE RETURN
music_tags: villain theme, low brass, sustained cluster strings, slow timpani, sinister, opp
script: This library has four hundred thousand books. All of them are accounted for.
Except one, which was borrowed in 1954 and returned last Thursday.
Nobody used a card. The desk was locked. The book is warm.

title: FLOOR THIRTEEN
hook: the building has twelve / the lift has thirteen
music_tags: quiet tense strings, low pulse, anticipation, restrained orchestral, instrumenta
script: This building has twelve floors. The plans say twelve. The windows count to twelve.
The lift has a button for thirteen.
It is not a mistake. People have pressed it.

title: THE SIGNAL
music_tags: cold industrial electronic, metallic percussion loop, analog bass drone, detuned
script: This dish has pointed at the same patch of sky for forty years.
Ninety seconds ago it heard something. It heard it again ninety seconds before that.
The building was decommissioned in the spring.
captions: Forty years, one patch of sky

title: LOW TIDE
hook: the sea went out / and did not come back
music_tags: desolate solo piano, distant strings, loss, very sparse, instrumental
script: The tide goes out twice a day. Everyone here knows the timing by heart.
On Tuesday it went out at nine. On Wednesday it did not come back.
There is a road down there. There was never a road down there.
captions: On Wednesday it did not come back
There is a road down there

title: CAFFEINE + THEANINE
music_tags: hopeful rising strings, arpeggiated piano, soft swelling brass, gentle percussio
script: Caffeine blocks the signal that makes you feel tired. It does not add energy - it hides the debt.
Green tea carries theanine alongside it, which is why tea tends to feel smoother than the same caffeine from coffee.
Together they show up in the research as steadier attention with less of the jittery edge.
The catch is the same as always: it has a long tail, and afternoon coffee is tomorrow's tiredness.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: It hides tiredness, it does not add energy
Theanine is why tea feels smoother

title: CREATINE
music_tags: driving percussion, ostinato strings, insistent low brass, forward motion, instr
script: Creatine is the most studied sports supplement there is.
Your muscles store it as phosphocreatine, and use it to recycle energy during short, hard efforts.
That mostly shows up in the last rep or two of a heavy set. Small, but real, and it adds up over months.
The research also looks at effects beyond the gym, but that work is younger and less settled.
It is cheap, it is well studied, and it is not magic.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: The most studied one on the shelf
It recycles energy for short hard efforts
Shows up in the last rep or two
Other effects are still being studied

title: FIBRE
hook: fibre / the boring one that works
music_tags: warm nostalgic strings, soft piano, gentle, hazy, wistful, instrumental
script: Fibre is the least glamorous thing on this list and probably the one most people are short on.
Some of it dissolves and slows digestion. Some of it does not, and keeps things moving.
It also feeds the bacteria in your gut, which is where a lot of the current research is pointed.
One practical note: add it slowly and drink water, or you will regret the enthusiasm.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.

title: MAGNESIUM
music_tags: warm nostalgic strings, soft piano, gentle, hazy, wistful, instrumental
script: Magnesium is not one thing. What it is bound to changes how much you absorb.
Most people get some from food. Seeds, greens, beans, whole grains.
Different forms are marketed for different things - sleep, digestion, muscle cramps - and the evidence is stronger for some than others.
The honest summary: correcting a real shortfall helps. Adding more on top of enough usually does not.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: Fixing a shortfall helps; more does not

title: OMEGA-3
music_tags: gentle sunrise ambient, soft solo piano, warm string pad, distant solo clarinet,
script: Omega-3s are fats your body cannot make. You have to eat them.
Two of them do most of the work in the research: EPA and DHA. Both come mainly from marine sources.
Eating fish a couple of times a week gets most people there without a bottle.
Supplements are for filling the gap when that does not happen. Freshness matters more than people think - rancid oil is common.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: EPA and DHA do most of the work
Fish twice a week gets most people there
Freshness matters more than people think

title: PROTEIN
music_tags: driving montage rock, muted electric guitar ostinato, four on the floor kick, sn
script: Protein is the one most people already understand and still get slightly wrong.
The research points at a daily total, spread across the day - not a magic window right after training.
Powder is a convenience, not a category of its own. It is food that happens to be easy to carry.
Needs go up if you are training hard or older. They do not go up to the numbers on the tub.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: Most people get this slightly wrong
Needs go up - not that far up

title: SLEEP & MELATONIN
hook: melatonin / it is a clock, not a sedative
music_tags: late night jazz, muted trumpet, brushed drums, upright bass, rhodes piano, smoky
script: Melatonin is a timing signal, not a sedative. It tells your body it is night.
Bright light late in the evening delays that signal. Which is why the phone is part of the problem.
The clearest use in the research is jet lag and shifted schedules - moving the clock, not forcing sleep.
For ordinary bad sleep, the dull advice still beats the bottle: same wake time, dark room, less light at night.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: A timing signal, not a sedative
Late bright light delays the signal

title: VITAMIN D
music_tags: gentle sunrise ambient, soft solo piano, warm string pad, distant solo clarinet,
script: Your skin makes vitamin D from sunlight. That is the whole reason this one is complicated.
Far from the equator, in winter, the sun sits too low for your skin to make much of it at all.
Some comes from food. Oily fish, egg yolks, fortified milk.
It is one of the few where a blood test actually tells you where you stand, instead of guessing.
General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
captions: Your skin makes it from sunlight
In winter, far north, the sun is too low
A blood test tells you where you stand
